title: Pokémon TCG COPPERAJAH ex Scarlet & Violet Paldea Evolved 150/193 Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the powerful Copperajah, a Stage 1 Pokémon with an impressive 300 HP. The card is from the Scarlet & Violet Paldea Evolved set, and is a Double Rare card with a Holo finish. 

This card is perfect for collectors and players alike, and is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection. The card is in English and manufactured by The Pokémon Company, ensuring its quality and authenticity. Don't miss out on the chance to own this incredible card!
